title: Контраст: Настоящее vs Прошлое (Cont vs PastCont)
description: Выбери правильную форму, опираясь на маркер (now или at 5 PM).

items.question: Look! He (is playing / was playing) football now.
At 5 PM he (is playing / was playing) football.
Now we (are watching / were watching) TV.
Yesterday at 8 we (are watching / were watching) TV.
She (is reading / was reading) a book at the moment.
She (is reading / was reading) a book at noon.
